title: Compiled same-language shared-host FMC computational-value screen
purpose: Determine whether the D24-qualified FMC hydraulic architecture plausibly occupies a useful computational-cost versus hydrological-fidelity frontier when implemented in compiled Fortran and compared with R2/R16 on the exact D24 workload, without making a formal performance claim on an unadmitted shared host.

scientific_role.statement: D25 screens whether further FMC application-fidelity research is computationally justified. It does not establish a portable speedup.

performance_governance.implication: D25 timing is screening evidence only. No result may be called a formal SWAP5/MultiSWAP CPU baseline, qualified speedup or production-performance claim.

frozen_workload.bottom: fixed zero pressure head at 160 cm
frozen_workload.initial_state: D24 composite surface fronts + G25 groundwater fronts

compiled_FMC_identity.compiler: same GNU Fortran toolchain as R2/R16 within one workflow run
compiled_FMC_identity.scientific_equations: exact D24 FMC route: gray demand + Eq.18 surface-front advance + conservative relaxation + D22 surface reservoir + G25 Eq.21 groundwater-front advance + conservative relaxation + D24 bottom-exchange ledger

stage1_implementation_equivalence.oracle: Frozen D24 Python equations regenerated on the D25 execution branch from the source-bound D24 oracle, before timing.
required_for_O0_and_O2: same runoff/no-runoff event presence by interval
per-step soil storage absolute difference <=1e-11 cm
per-step cumulative infiltration absolute difference <=1e-11 cm
per-step surface store absolute difference <=1e-11 cm
per-step cumulative runoff absolute difference <=1e-11 cm
per-step cumulative bottom exchange absolute difference <=1e-11 cm
per-step each mapped theta16 absolute difference <=1e-12
per-step terminal bottom flux absolute difference <=1e-9 cm/day
Fortran global and local ledger gates <=1e-12 cm
stage1_implementation_equivalence.failure_rule: Any equivalence failure closes D25 before timing. No equation, bin, process-step, ordering, surface law, lambda, threshold or tolerance may be retuned inside D25.

stage2_R16_only_timing_calibration.purpose: Choose internal batch repetitions without seeing FMC or R2 timing effects.
stage2_R16_only_timing_calibration.rule: Select the first repetition count whose in-process Fortran CPU_TIME for repeated complete D24 workloads is >=0.5 s and <=8 s. If none reaches 0.5 s by 1024, close timing as unresolved. If first qualifying value exceeds 8 s, use its previous candidate only if previous CPU_TIME >=0.25 s; otherwise close unresolved.

stage3_screening_protocol.primary_measure: in-process Fortran CPU_TIME around the repeated scientific workload, excluding compilation and stdout serialization
stage3_screening_protocol.diagnostic_measure: external monotonic elapsed time per sample
stage3_screening_protocol.order: six permutations of FMC/R2/R16 repeated five times in a frozen cycle
stage3_screening_protocol.physical_output_check: Every measured sample must return the same deterministic scientific checksum as its Stage-1 qualified route.

screening_decision.rationale: Because D24 already establishes that FMC is hydrologically more accurate than R2 on all eight frozen gates, FMC need not be faster than R2 to be non-dominated. It must show a credible cost advantage over R16 to remain computationally relevant.
screening_decision.positive_rule: Stage 1 passes; Stage 2 calibrates; all samples pass scientific checks; paired mean FMC-R16 CPU delta is <0 and its mean + 2*SE is <0.
screening_decision.unresolved_rule: Stage 1 passes and timing completes, but the sign of the FMC-vs-R16 cost advantage is not resolved by the frozen two-SE screening criterion or mean/median disagree.
screening_decision.negative_rule: Stage 1 passes, timing completes, and both mean and median FMC/R16 CPU ratios are >=1.
screening_decision.frontier_report: Always report R2 cost position separately; do not collapse cost and fidelity into a weighted score.

successor_logic.if_positive: Retain FMC as a computationally plausible bounded hydraulic research candidate. Next research should expand purpose-specific fidelity (ET/root uptake and longer/seasonal water balance) while preserving the D24 physics; formal speedup still waits for an admitted isolated host and a production-relevant implementation.
successor_logic.if_unresolved: Do not retune science. Either repeat only on an admitted isolated performance host or continue fidelity research without a speed claim if scientifically justified.
successor_logic.if_negative: Do not escalate FMC toward general ROM/application qualification until a scientifically justified cost reduction exists; no bin/process-step retuning is authorized from D25.
